section: Crestron with AVI-SPL: DM NVX, AirMedia, Collab Compute, intelligent video, room control and XiO Cloud
body:
AVI-SPL's Crestron page describes the Crestron product families it delivers and how the two companies work together. It helps a consultant explain what Crestron contributes to a room: content distribution, wireless sharing, conferencing compute, camera intelligence, control and cloud management.

**About Crestron and the partnership**
- Crestron develops technology for spaces from desktops to boardrooms and from offices to global enterprises. Its solutions integrate with existing environments while preparing organizations for future needs.
- It offers platforms, devices and systems for communication and collaboration, all managed by a cloud-based system for deployment, monitoring and upgrading.
- AVI-SPL and Crestron partner on integrated solutions for the modern workplace and flexible work environments. The page cites over 5 decades of innovation and names the aims as better communication, higher productivity and technology standardized across the organization, through content sharing, intelligent collaboration solutions and intuitive control systems designed for hybrid work environments.

**What Crestron delivers, as listed**
- Content delivered across workplaces, campuses and command centers without delays or dropouts.
- Hybrid collaboration that is inclusive, using AI-driven video, clear audio and simple wireless sharing.
- Responsive automation for room control, adjusting to users, schedules and the needs of the room.
- Built-in protections for secure collaboration, said to meet enterprise and government compliance standards.

**Product families**
- **Crestron DM NVX** (AV-over-IP): distributes up to 5K video, audio, USB and control across the network, with real-time performance and built-in security.
- **AirMedia**: wireless presentation and conferencing from any device, with no cables.
- **Crestron Collab Compute**: a purpose-built platform with professional I/O and AI-ready performance. The page says it allows faster deployment, management of all spaces from one seat and a consistent One Touch Join experience.
- **AI-powered intelligent video**: AI-enabled multi-camera switching so that everyone in the room is seen and naturally framed.
- **Control**: management of lighting, AV and environmental settings with responsive automation aimed at efficiency, comfort and control.
- **XiO Cloud platform**: simplifies how Crestron and third-party devices are provisioned, monitored and managed, using real-time alerts, remote updates and insights; intended to reduce downtime and scale IT control globally.

**Real-Time Design with Crestron**
The page promotes an experience for validating Crestron room designs before they are built, with no headset or specialty hardware needed.

**When to use this**
Use when a customer asks what Crestron offers for meeting rooms, how content is shared or distributed, how Crestron devices are managed remotely, or whether a Crestron room design can be checked before building.

**Not stated in this source**
No model numbers, compatible meeting platforms, certifications or prices are given.
